title: Optimization of cold spray additive manufactured AA2024/Al2O3 metal matrix composite with heat treatment
InformationInFigures: Yes. Tensile dimensions (Fig. 2), Porosity (Fig. 4), hardness (Fig. 10), UTS and Elongation (Fig. 14)

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Chemical_Composition: Cu 3.8-4.9 wt%, Mg 1.2-1.8 wt%, Mn 0.3-0.9 wt%, Si 0.5 wt%, Fe 0.5 wt%, Zn 0.25 wt%, Ti 0.15 wt%, Others 0.15 wt%, balance Al
preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: Beijing Xing Rong Yuan Technology Co. Ltd., China
preSprayedProperties.Secondary_Powder_Source: Beijing Xing Rong Yuan Technology Co. Ltd., China
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: AA2024 has a somewhat spherical/irregular shape, Al2O3 has an irregular/angular shape. rarely occurring pores in AA2024, and has a cellular grain structure
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Heat_Treatment_Description: mechanically mixed in a ball mill machine then dried for 30 mins at 80°C
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Material_Composition: 3.8-4.9 wt% Cu, 1.2-1.8 wt% Mg, 0.3-0.9 wt% Mn, 0.5 wt% Si, 0.5 wt% Fe, 0.25 wt% Zn, 0.15 wt% Ti, 0.15 wt% Others, Bal Al

experimentalProperties.Raster_Pattern: two-pass building strategy with a zig-zag pattern
experimentalProperties.Tensile_Test_Orientation: parallel to the direction of the spray gun movement
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: deposits separated from substrate by wire electrical cutting. metallographic samples were ground followed by fine grinding and mechanical polishing.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: dense with low porosity. deformed and elongated grains, and the refined grains (close to the ceramic particles) can be observed
